lessons.title: Enter installer level 3 and protect programming

steps.title: Enter the four-digit practice Engineer code
steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 3A.

steps.title: Remove the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Removing the cover alone leaves access at 3A.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable ON
steps.expected: Engineer access 3B; programming may now be confirmed.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable OFF
steps.expected: Access 3A; confirmed settings remain stored.

steps.title: Refit the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Cover refitted; switch remains OFF.

steps.title: Return to Normal
steps.expected: Normal access; Write Enable OFF; no System Fault reminder.

lessons.summary: Normal access; Write Enable OFF; no System Fault reminder.

lessons.title: Disable and restore a whole zone

steps.title: Enter the four-digit practice Supervisor code
steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 2B.

steps.title: Select Zone 1 input disablement
steps.expected: Zone 1 selected. This affects all inputs in this zone; it is not individual-device disablement.

steps.title: Disable the inputs
steps.expected: Zone 1 input disabled immediately. The zone supply remains ON.

steps.title: Apply a fictional MCP on Zone 1
steps.expected: The disabled input causes no alarm event or action.

steps.title: Clear the fictional MCP
steps.expected: Clear the input before restoring the zone.

steps.title: Restore Zone 1 inputs
steps.expected: Zone 1 enabled; no disablement remains.

lessons.title: Isolate zone supply for fictional device work

steps.title: Enter the four-digit practice Engineer code
steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 3A.

steps.title: Remove the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Removing the cover alone leaves access at 3A.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable ON
steps.expected: Engineer access 3B; programming may now be confirmed.

steps.title: Select Zone 1 status
steps.expected: Applied zone supply is ON. This differs from input disablement.

steps.title: Store Zone OFF
steps.expected: OFF stored, but active supply remains ON until a system reset.

steps.title: Apply the stored status
steps.expected: Zone 1 supply is now OFF in this simulation.

steps.title: Acknowledge fictional device work
steps.expected: No address enrolment occurs. The source is a zone system; follow the actual device wiring and compatibility manual onsite.

steps.title: Store and apply Zone ON
steps.expected: Zone 1 supply restored; no pending configuration.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable OFF
steps.expected: Access 3A; confirmed settings remain stored.

steps.title: Refit the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Cover refitted; switch remains OFF.

steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 2B.

steps.title: Choose Zone 1 Silent Test

lessons.title: Program and verify a zone output delay

steps.title: Enter the four-digit practice Engineer code
steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 3A.

steps.title: Remove the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Removing the cover alone leaves access at 3A.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable ON
steps.expected: Engineer access 3B; programming may now be confirmed.

steps.title: Set Zone 1 outputs to DELAYED
steps.expected: Stored selection; not applied yet.

steps.title: Set a one-minute delay
steps.expected: One minute stored; reset still required.

steps.title: Allow delay at the zone of origin
steps.expected: SETTING applied. The source default INSTANT would otherwise override delay on the initiating zone.

steps.title: Apply a fictional smoke alarm
steps.expected: Zone 1 fire is indicated; its programmed sounders wait for the delay.

steps.title: Advance one simulated minute
steps.expected: Zone 1 delayed sounders now operate.

steps.title: Silence alarms
steps.expected: Alarm outputs silenced; fire indication remains.

steps.title: Clear the fictional detector input
steps.expected: Clear input before reset.

steps.title: Reset the indication
steps.expected: No active fire remains. Programmed delay is retained for this fictional exercise.

steps.title: Switch Write Enable OFF
steps.expected: Access 3A; confirmed settings remain stored.

steps.title: Refit the right-hand cover
steps.expected: Cover refitted; switch remains OFF.

lessons.title: Silence, investigate and reset an alarm

steps.title: Enter the four-digit practice Supervisor code
steps.expected: Accepted on the fourth digit; no ENTER needed. Access 2B.

steps.title: Silence the alarms
steps.expected: Sounders stop; buzzer and fire indication remain.

steps.title: Silence the internal buzzer
steps.expected: Buzzer silenced separately.

steps.title: Try reset while the input remains
steps.expected: The active fictional detector reasserts; reset cannot clear a persistent input.

steps.title: Silence again
steps.expected: Sounders silenced.

steps.title: Clear the fictional detector after investigating
steps.expected: Input removed; latched indication remains until reset.

steps.title: Reset the panel
steps.expected: Fire indication clears; the event history remains.

lessons.summary: Fire indication clears; the event history remains.

knownLimits: All events, zone labels, device-work acknowledgements and timings are fictional training data.
Zone disablement ignores all inputs in that zone; Zone Status OFF is a separate installer supply-off setting. There is no addressed-device enrolment menu.
Level3A permits engineer review; programming changes require the exposed Write Enable switch at3B and a system reset to take effect. Operator disable/test actions are separate.
Exact alphanumeric multi-tap timing, external input electrical effects, peripheral supervision, unavailable panel networking and printer functionality remain reference-only.
Source System Test description duplicates local audible test; no all-zone sound pattern is inferred. Peripheral ON/OFF examples repeat option numbers; no guessed numeric sequence is supplied.
The training clock advances only through labelled assists. Approximately five-second walk-test reset is a source approximation, not measured firmware timing.
Display contents and post-reset view continuity are illustrative; source menus, physical keys, choices and access boundaries are retained.
